fusions.name: Rearing Kick
fusions.desc: A rearing kick that deals 14 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Stamping Ground
fusions.desc: Stamps the ground, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. The blow ignores armour.

fusions.name: Spooked Strength
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Cornered Fury
fusions.desc: When your health falls low, your physical damage rises 40% for 8 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.
